name: Scroll Area
summary: Single native overflow container with optional region naming, visible keyboard focus, standards-based scrollbar styling, coarse-pointer affordance, and forced-colors fallback without custom scroll runtime.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Single native overflow container; consumer content remains ordinary descendants.

states.name: thumbHover
states.description: Pointer hover on the non-standard WebKit fallback only; standards-based scrollbars choose their own interaction rendering.

states.name: focus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus for a directly scrollable named region.

behavior.name: nativeScrolling
behavior.description: The component should preserve native scrolling behavior instead of replacing it with custom drag-only mechanics.

behavior.name: keyboardAccess
behavior.description: When overflow is not reachable through child focus, the consumer supplies a label and maps the same root to role=region and tabindex=0; otherwise redundant landmark and focus stops are omitted.

behavior.name: scrollbarStyling
behavior.description: Scrollbar styling is progressive enhancement and must not remove platform scroll affordances.

behavior.name: pointerAndContrastAdaptation
behavior.description: Coarse pointers receive the platform auto-width scrollbar and forced colors restores system scrollbar colors.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: The base component adds no wrapper geometry, drag simulation, observers, listeners, timers, or runtime assets.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for a focusable scroll region when surrounding context does not already provide one.

accessibility: Preserve native scrolling and platform scrollbar behavior.
Make the root a focusable named region only when keyboard users need to scroll overflow content directly and descendant focus does not already provide access.
Do not hide scrollbars when overflow content needs to be discoverable.
Ensure content inside the scroll area remains reachable by keyboard and assistive technology.
Preserve visible focus, system scrollbar colors in forced-colors, and platform-sized scroll affordances for coarse pointers.

web.notes: Implemented as one native overflow node in components/css/layout.css; CSS Scrollbars styling is primary and WebKit pseudo-elements are progressive target enhancement.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid renders the same native overflow class contract and supplies role, tabindex, and accessible naming only when its content requires direct keyboard scrolling.
